name: Green Oaks Village
demographics: Green Oaks Village serves a diverse middle-income demographic in west Arlington, attracting families and working professionals from the surrounding residential neighborhoods. The trade area consists primarily of homeowners aged 30-65 with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $90,000, seeking convenient access to grocery shopping and everyday services. The center draws regular weekly shoppers who value the Kroger anchor for routine household needs, along with quick-service dining and essential retail options that cater to time-conscious suburban lifestyles.
description: Green Oaks Village is a well-established community shopping center located on West Pleasant Ridge Road in Arlington, Texas, serving the west Arlington community with convenient retail and grocery services. Anchored by a Kroger supermarket, this neighborhood center has become a reliable destination for local residents seeking everyday shopping needs and essential services. The center maintains strong community ties with its accessible location and practical tenant mix that caters to the daily needs of surrounding neighborhoods. With a solid 4.3-star rating from over 1,200 reviews, Green Oaks Village has earned its reputation as a dependable shopping destination. Operating with extended hours from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM, the center provides flexibility for shoppers with varying schedules, making it a convenient stop for early morning grocery runs or evening errands.
summary: Green Oaks Village is a community shopping center in west Arlington anchored by Kroger, providing convenient grocery shopping and essential services to local residents. With extended operating hours and a strong community reputation, it serves as a reliable neighborhood destination for everyday needs.
